responseText: Dunzchasm sent ye? Well now, another fresh face in Hammer Rest. Good to see it. Probably sent ya without any tools, I'd imagine. There are plenty laying around here. They're not the best, but as Dwarven forged they'll get ya through until ye can get some better ones.
name: ANV_FTUE_Dunir_GarrimHammersong_5_Response
